title: Adult Pottery Class
evidence_sentence: The class page states the studio includes 'wood/soda firing' kilns and that the $210 fee 'includes clay, glazes and use of all studio tools and equipment and firings.'
evidence_quote: 3 large electric kiln offering mid-range firings, barrel firing, wood/soda firing
summary: 6-week pottery class for all levels meeting 6–9 PM weekly; includes wheel and hand-building with access to wood/soda and barrel firings. Fee $210 includes clay, glazes, tools, and firings.
cost_text: $210 (6 weeks) includes clay, glazes and use of all studio tools and equipment and firings
how_to_join: Sign up through pottery class enrollment page
